dsl:
search synth, filter, render, points, mixer, classicNoisedeck

let osc1 = osc(type: oscKind.saw)
let osc2 = osc(type: oscKind.noise, min: 0.65, max: 0.9, seed: 4220)
let highsReact = audio(band: 2, min: -70, max: -140)

noise(
  type: catmullRom3x3,
  octaves: 1,
  scaleX: 100,
  scaleY: 1,
  loopOffset: verticalScan,
  loopScale: 100,
  speed: highsReact
)
  .seamless(repeat: 1)
  .translate(y: osc1)
  .posterize(
    levels: 16,
    gamma: 0.7,
    _skip: true
  )
  .wormhole(
    kink: 0.1,
    stride: 2,
    rotation: -22
  )
  .edge(
    size: kernel7x7,
    amount: 500,
    mix: 0
  )
  .subchain(name: "feedback loop with warp", id: "dqq0") {
    .loopBegin(alpha: 89.83, intensity: 81.01)
    .warp(
      strength: 100,
      scale: 0.25,
      speed: 1,
      wrap: repeat
    )
    .loopEnd()
  }
  .subchain(name: "lens effects", id: "c9dk") {
    .snow(alpha: 0.86, density: 9.93)
    .chromaticAberration(aberration: 13.6, passthru: 74.69)
    .crt(alpha: 0.57)
    .bloom(
      threshold: 0.75,
      softKnee: 0.11,
      intensity: 0.55,
      taps: 32
    )
    .lens(displacement: -0.5)
    .vignette(brightness: 0.26, alpha: 0.72)
    .motionBlur()
    .smooth()
  }
  .adjust(
    rotation: 104.08,
    hueRange: 57.93,
    saturation: 0.87,
    brightness: 0.9,
    contrast: 0.77
  )
  .write(o0)

render(o0)
